after.setting: environment variable SEC_USER_AGENT (the existing supported configuration path)

after.offline_work: fixtures, stored-source replay (the Microchip journey ran this way), calculations and export verification need no setting

verification: mock transport only; no live SEC request was made: unusable values refused with zero requests issued across both SEC hosts; an explicit value sent verbatim; the identity absent from every written record
